note: frozen lists closed records whose links are not validated: a path ending in / covers that directory, any other entry is one file. Their text checks still run. exclusions suppresses one remark-validate-links finding each in a file that is still checked: source is repository-relative, reasonIncludes is matched after backslashes are normalized to slashes, and it must hit exactly one finding. inspiration/ is excluded by .remarkrc.mjs, not by this list.
